arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ إِذا زُلزِلَتِ الأَرضُ زِلزالَها
translation: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake
And Earth yieldeth up her burdens
And man saith: What aileth her
That day she will relate her chronicles

arabic: يَومَئِذٍ يَصدُرُ النّاسُ أَشتاتًا لِيُرَوا أَعمٰلَهُم
transliteration: Yawmaithin yasduru alnnasu ashtatan liyuraw aAAmalahum
translation: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds

arabic: فَمَن يَعمَل مِثقالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيرًا يَرَهُ
transliteration: Faman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin khayran yarahu
translation: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then

arabic: وَمَن يَعمَل مِثقالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ
transliteration: Waman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin sharran yarahu
translation: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then
